Container.Name: step-ca
Container.Overview:
Private Certificate Authority for Unraid, providing trusted HTTPS certificates for services on your LAN and an internal ACME server for automated certificate issuance - built on Smallstep's open-source step-ca.
Rather than self-signing each internal service's certificate separately (and having to trust every one of them individually), step-ca lets you run your own CA: trust its single root certificate once, and every certificate it issues - for any internal hostname - is trusted automatically. Pair it with an ACME-capable reverse proxy to issue and renew those certificates without any manual steps.
step-ca can also issue SSH certificates and be used as a general-purpose X.509 CA; the ACME/TLS use case above is just the most common reason to run it on Unraid.
On first start (when the appdata directory is empty), the container initializes a brand-new root and intermediate CA using the "CA Name" and "DNS Names" values below. Keep the appdata volume safe afterwards: it holds your root CA's private key, and must survive container recreation and image upgrades.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: acme pki tls ssh certificate authority ca smallstep step
Container.Requires: Set "CA Name" and "DNS Names" before the first start - they are only applied while the appdata path is empty. Internet access is only needed to pull the image, not to run the CA.

Config.Name: CA Port
Config.Description: Port the CA listens on for HTTPS and ACME requests.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent CA state: root/intermediate keys, database and config. Must be empty the first time you start the container so step-ca can initialize.

Config.Name: CA Name
Config.Description: Friendly name for your CA, e.g. 'Home Lab CA'. Only read during first-run initialization.

Config.Name: DNS Names
Config.Description: Comma-separated hostnames/IPs clients will use to reach this CA, e.g. 'ca.home.arpa,192.168.1.10'. Only read during first-run initialization.

Config.Name: Enable ACME
Config.Description: Enable the built-in ACME provisioner on first run, so other services can request certificates automatically (true/false). Only read during first-run initialization.

Config.Name: CA Password
Config.Description: Password used to encrypt the CA's private keys on first run. Leave blank to auto-generate a random password, which is printed once to the container log - check the log right after first start. Only read during first-run initialization.

Config.Name: Provisioner Name
Config.Description: Name of the default JWK provisioner created on first run.

Config.Name: Enable SSH CA
Config.Description: Enable SSH certificate authority support on first run (true/false).

Config.Name: Enable Remote Management
Config.Description: Enable step-ca's remote administration API on first run (true/false), so provisioners can be managed with 'step ca admin' instead of editing config files.

Config.Name: Admin Subject
Config.Description: Admin username created when Remote Management is enabled.
